analysis.title: Marketcolour + CTA Update / SBM (I) / Richemont / Enel
key_insights: US equities fell on 17 Nov 2026: SPX -192bps to 7416 with 8 of 11 sectors down, NDX -267bps to 27197, RTY -170bps to 2742. VIX rose 18.55% to 23.
Tech led the decline at -2.98%, followed by Communication Services at -2.82% and Energy at -2.09%. Staples rose 0.34%.
Semiconductors and AI-linked names sold off: NVDA -4.5%, DRAM -6%, SMH -5%, Neoclouds -7%. The GS AI Semis basket fell 5.48% and the GS Power Up America basket fell 3.09%.
In Europe, EU Semis fell 2.3% and Miners fell 2.7% (AAL LN -4.3%, BHP LN -3.5%, ANTO LN -3.1%, RIO LN -2.1%). EU Defense rose 70bps. SX5E has outperformed SPX by about 8% since early October.
Average trade size in the total US market is down 47% since 2008 to 136 shares per trade. On-exchange average trade size excluding the opening and closing auctions is 108 shares year-to-date.

GS basket idea: EU Staples (GSXESTAP Index) look vulnerable. They just had their best monthly performance on record, while 1-year forward EPS revisions lagged the market by more than 10pp YTD. The sector trades at a 16% premium to SXXP.
CTAs are long Europe and short US. Short-term thresholds in Europe are about 2% lower. CTAs are as short NDX as they have been in the last decade.

US-listed ETF shorts fell 8.6%, the largest percentage covering in 7 months, led by Large Cap Equity, Credit and Tech ETFs. Global equity funds took in +$98bn in the week ending November 11, against +$89bn the week before, with DM inflows driven mainly by US funds.

SBM Offshore: initiation with a EUR43 price target and 25% upside. SBM is the global leader in FPSOs with about 40% market share. GS sees a deepwater FID wave building across Guyana, Brazil and West Africa and expects consensus to understate the pace of FPSO awards.

Richemont: Buy, price target raised to CHF230 from CHF225, 30% upside. 2027E EBIT margin forecast rises to 23.1% (22.2% excluding one-offs) from 21.9%, lifting adjusted EPS by 6.1%. The 2027E improvement is mainly a one-off tariff refund. 2028-30E EPS upgrades are 1.7-2.7%.

Enel: Buy, price target EUR12, 20% upside. A Strategic Update is due in Feb-2027, possibly at a CMD. GS sees upside risk to current targets despite regulatory intervention. 2028E clean EPS is EUR0.83 (about 11.5x P/E), slightly ahead of guidance and Visible Alpha Consensus. 2030E is EUR0.92 (10.5x P/E), a touch ahead of guidance and 9% above the street.

market_movers.rationale: SBM Offshore leads the FPSO market with about 40% share. GS expects a deepwater FID wave in Guyana, Brazil and West Africa that consensus does not price. The rating is not stated in the text and is shown as Buy only as the nearest label to a 25% upside initiation.
Richemont target raised from CHF225 after strong margin delivery excluding one-offs. The 2027E uplift is mainly a one-off tariff refund.
Enel has a Strategic Update due in Feb-2027. GS sees upside risk to targets, with 2028E and 2030E clean EPS ahead of guidance.

sector_views.rationale: The sector had its best monthly performance on record while 1-year forward EPS revisions lagged the market by more than 10pp YTD. It trades at a 16% premium to SXXP.

earnings_insights: Richemont: GS raises 2027E EBIT margin to 23.1% (22.2% excluding one-offs) from 21.9%, a GS estimate. Adjusted EPS rises 6.1% for 2027E and 1.7-2.7% for 2028-30E. The 2027E improvement mainly reflects a one-off tariff refund.

Enel: GS estimates 2028E clean EPS of EUR0.83 (about 11.5x P/E), slightly ahead of guidance and Visible Alpha Consensus. GS estimates 2030E at EUR0.92 (10.5x P/E), a touch ahead of guidance and 9% ahead of the street. A Strategic Update is expected in Feb-2027.
SBM Offshore: GS believes current consensus does not reflect the pace of FPSO awards it expects.
